# Sam's News — anthropic — 2026-10-15

## Business/Funding

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Anthropic revenue surges 46% to $16.8 billion ahead of IPO
Anthropic reported Q3 2026 revenue of $16.8 billion, up 46% from $11.5 billion in Q2, with nine-month cumulative revenue of ~$33.1 billion. The company achieved adjusted profitability for the second consecutive quarter with 85% adjusted gross margin and positive cash flow. Anthropic targets a $2 trillion+ valuation for its anticipated post-November IPO, implying a 27–30x price-to-sales multiple.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Q3 2026 revenue $16.8B (+46% QoQ); Q1 $4.8B; 9-month total ~$33.1B</li>
<li>Adjusted profitability Q2–Q3 consecutive; adjusted gross margin 85%; operating margin &gt;11%</li>
<li>Company committed $518B+ towards cloud computing over next decade</li>
<li>Targeting $2 trillion+ valuation; Q2 saw 100%+ QoQ growth vs. 46% Q3 normalization</li>
</ul>
